page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes at the right (Exo.20, 25, Deut. 27.5); handwritten annotations in the right margin are not printed and are left out. Running head at top with page number 125.

main_text.l: Moses seruus Iehouæ filiis Israel: sicut
scriptum est in libro Legis Mosis, alta-
re ex lapidibus integris, superquos nō
bus repetitam Legem Mosis, quā scri-
res eius, & præfecti, & Iudices eius sta-
bant hinc & inde ad arcam coram sa-
34 Et posthæc legit omnia verba Le-
secundum id totum quod scriptū est

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations at right (not printed). Marginal references Exo.20. 25. and Deut. 27.5 are transcribed as printed; the second is set as "27.5" in the printed margin. Some words in the text are doubtful, e.g. "benedicer et" as printed.
